reason: Response 2 has sharp, practical gates, such as test-existence checks, a time-of-check-to-time-of-use merge race and an audit of the internal repos, but Response 1 better serves the team because it covers over-reliance, disclosure and cross-tenant leakage, structures each verification with controls, owner-set thresholds, stop conditions and reviewers, is honest about small-sample limits, and routes liability and regulatory questions to counsel, which Response 2 omits entirely.
